raw_definitions: Definisi : 2. young and small, kecil: a kindergarten for ~ tots, sebuah tadika utk budak-budak kecil. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : adj 1. extremely small, sangat kecil; ( when qualifying degree, amount, etc ) sedikit; ( of bacteria etc ) halus: she has a ~ little room up in the attic, dia ada bilik yg sangat kecil di loteng; she felt a ~ bit better after the short rest, dia berasa sihat sedikit selepas berehat sekejap; a ~ speck of dust, butir habuk yg halus; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
